messages:
Maya (oncall): morning handoff — i'm primary until 18:00 UTC. quick heads-up: we're seeing elevated 5xx + p99 latency on inference-prod-us-east. not customer-reported yet, pausing any non-urgent rollouts.
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: inference-prod-us-east p99 latency spike. Pager routed to #oncall. Incident ID INC-2026-042.
Ravi: on it, grabbing logs. any customer-facing tickets yet?
Maya (oncall): Not yet. thresholds hit but self-healing attempts are running. i'll drop a short checklist below for immediate triage.
June: i'm secondary for the next 2h, standing by.
Ravi: quick triage plan — check model pool and pod health. commands i usually run:
`rdctl pool status inference-prod-us-east --json`
`kubectl get pods -n inference | grep modelserver`
if you see OOMs, consider `rdctl pool scale --shrink 1` or move traffic off the offending node.
Maya (oncall): Runbooks pinned here:
- Fallback routing & warm nodes: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/fallback-routing
- Model worker OOMs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-worker-oom
- Queue backlog & throttling: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/queue-throttle
Carla: if we need a quick canary revert: `redwood rollout cancel --target inference-prod-us-east`
Ravi: logs show repeated `OOMKilled` on modelserver-3 and kv cache eviction bursts. trimmed excerpt:
```
E OOMKilled at 0x7f2a
I Evicted 128MB kvcache for model-legacy-v2
W retrying request 502
```
Maya (oncall): Immediate mitigation (short checklist):
1) Spin up hot-spare nodes: `rdctl pool ops-scale --hot-spare 2`
2) Route low-priority traffic off legacy models: `redwood route update --policy priority=high --exclude model-legacy-v2`
3) If OOM persists, restart affected pod: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/modelserver --namespace=inference --pod=modelserver-3`
Ravi: doing step 1 now.
ops-bot: Action logged: runbook "model-worker-oom" started by Ravi.
June: muting noisy transient alerts on p99 > 3s for 15m to reduce churn :thumbsup:
Maya (oncall): Handoff note for 18:00 UTC — if retries continue past handoff, escalate to next rotation. quick customer impact note: estimated affected requests ~8-12% during 10:30-11:05 UTC window. no SLA breach observed at present.
Ravi: new nodes are up, memory pressure dropping. p99 down from ~3.8s to ~1.2s.
Maya (oncall): nice. i'll keep this thread open until handoff. if we see recurrent evictions, consider temporary quantized model variant (see Optimize note: https://redwood.internal/notes/quant-profiles).
Carla: i'll prepare a short handoff summary for incoming primary with the actions we've taken and checklist.
Maya (oncall): thanks. please also file a post-incident ticket and include the rollout history: `rdctl roll history inference-prod-us-east` — i'll add links before handoff.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 status: mitigated. p99 stable. Next action: create postmortem ticket INC-2026-042-PM.
Ravi: 👍
June: handing over secondary duties to Carla at 17:50 UTC :wave:
Maya (oncall): handoff complete at 17:58 UTC. passing primary to Carla for the evening. if anything spikes, ping @Carla and follow the runbooks above. :white_check_mark:
Carla: acknowledged. i'm primary until 01:00 UTC, runbook quick links pinned and monitoring.
